name: Soyuz MS-06
about: Soyuz MS-06 (2017-054A), a crewed vehicle (Soyuz MS), launched 2017 Sep 12. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2017 Sep 13), held fixed
docked to S36086; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
